title: Privacy Protection in Self-Evolving Personal Agents: Persistent Memory and Cross-Carrier Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2611.26983v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personal agents carry private experience into later decisions through persistent memory. This thematic survey compares memory admission, maintenance, release, and withdrawal by protected change, observer, and validation setting. Direct evidence in the screened corpus comes from controlled memory workflows. Three worked scenarios follow one private fact through booking, feedback-driven learning, and withdrawal. We show when prompt revision and memory reads compose, when skills inherit a private head's bound, and why reader non-use does not establish cleanup of learned state. Diagnostic experiments measure the utility costs of wider label protection and broad memory deletion, and test how missing lineage obscures descendants.

translated_title: 自进化个人智能体中的隐私保护：持久记忆与跨载体迁移
translated_abstract: 个人智能体通过持久记忆将私人经验带入后续决策之中。本主题综述按受保护变更、观察者和验证设置，比较了记忆的准入、维护、释放与撤回机制。筛选语料库中的直接证据来自受控记忆工作流。文章通过三个详细案例场景，追踪同一个隐私事实在预订、反馈驱动学习和撤回过程中的流转。我们展示了提示词修订与记忆读取何时可以组合生效，技能何时继承私有头部的约束，以及为什么读取者不再使用并不能证明已学习状态已被清理。诊断实验测量了更广泛标签保护和大规模记忆删除所带来的效用代价，并测试了缺失谱系信息如何导致衍生状态变得难以追踪。
tldr: 本综述系统比较了个人智能体持久记忆的隐私保护机制（准入、维护、释放与撤回），通过案例场景与诊断实验量化了标签保护和记忆删除的效用代价，并揭示了记忆谱系缺失导致的隐私清理隐患。
en_tdlr: This thematic survey systematically compares privacy protection mechanisms for persistent memory in self-evolving personal agents—admission, maintenance, release, and withdrawal—using worked scenarios and diagnostic experiments to quantify the utility costs of label protection and memory deletion while exposing risks from missing memory lineage.
